item.myfplus.resonant_haunted_bell.desc: Summons an empowered Bellringer, tolling with a thousand bells
item.myfplus.all_in_devils_ante.desc: Summons an empowered Dame Fortuna who bets everything
item.myfplus.sunset_dusk_key.desc: Summons an empowered Rosalyne, blade drawn against the setting sun
item.myfplus.ancient_jawbone.desc: Exclusive drop of the Ancient Swampjaw, amber still lodged between its teeth
item.myfplus.resonant_clapper.desc: Exclusive drop of the Resonant Bellringer, still humming faintly in your hand
item.myfplus.house_gilded_die.desc: Exclusive drop of the High-Roller Dame Fortuna, said to never roll a loss
item.myfplus.sunset_rose.desc: Exclusive drop of Rosalyne, Blade of Sunset, its petals frozen at dusk
item.myfplus.fossil_fang_bracelet.desc: Melee hits have a %1$s%% chance to plant a Swampjaw mine under the target; it soon explodes, dealing %3$s + %4$s%% of your attack damage to enemies within %2$s blocks; %5$ss cooldown
item.myfplus.resonant_belt_bell.desc: Every %1$sth consecutive hit rings a bell, firing Bellringer ghost lines at the target from four directions, each dealing %2$s%% of that hit; the count resets after 5s without a hit
item.myfplus.house_die_ring.desc: Hits have a %1$s%% chance to throw a Fortuna dice bomb at the target, bursting into 8 chip lines that each deal %2$s + %3$s%% of your attack damage; %4$ss cooldown; +%5$s Luck
item.myfplus.sunset_rose_cloak.desc: When hit in melee, fires a fan of 5 rose ghost lines at the attacker, each dealing %1$s + %2$s%% of your attack damage and stunning for %3$ss (bosses are not stunned); %4$ss cooldown. The lines cannot hit Rosalyne or rose spirits
